avis.titre: Great cleanser at a great price
avis.texte: My skin is noticeably smoother and brighter after using this product for just under two weeks. The exfoliation is gentle and the scent is so refreshing - highly recommended.

Im a long time user of Apricot scrub from St. Ives. I couldn't find it, so I bought this instead. I like it SO MUCH BETTER. It still exfoliating but it more of a buffing kinda way, not scratchy. Ill keep buying it.

avis.titre: Works as good as the expensive brands!
avis.texte: I've used St. Ives brand since I was a teen, but this particular variety exfoliant was the best! The granules are so small and gentle yet it polishes off the dead skin cells on my face as beautifully as a few big name brands I've used in the past. I absolutely love it!

avis.titre: Gentle exfoliation for face and body.
avis.texte: I wouldn’t use anything else but St. Ives for my face. I use a few times a week to exfoliate. Nice scent and gentle on my sensitive skin. Convenient packaging for the shower. Nice scent with no chemicals smell.
Always will have this available. It is still the only product that helps control oil.

avis.titre: Fine granular creamy scrub... good price!
avis.texte: Nice, light fragrance. I especially liked this fine granular scrub, instead of the coarse one I used to use with another company. The scrub is dense and creamy. Leaves skin soft. Price is reasonable.
Snells great! Scrub texture very mild. Will continue with this product or the apricot scrub.

avis.titre: Well made product, easy to use, instant results.
avis.texte: The go to face scrub with a lovely fragrant smell. Can see the results immediately, made with great quality. Highly recommended.
Livraison parfaite et dans les temps. Vraiment le meilleur gommage visage pour moi !

avis.titre: Been using this product for almost 15 years and will love it forever!💕
avis.texte: Been using St Ives since I was a teenager and I will love it forever! The Pink Lemon & Mandarin is my favorite though. It leaves my skin smooth and bright and it smells like sour candy 🩷

Much lighter and softer grit than original. Doesn’t feel like ‘it’s scrubbing’ like original does but skin actually looks exfoliated afterwards. Consistency it’s wetter and looser . See pic. Smell a little perfumey…not crazy about it. Not terrible tho. May go back to original formula.
I received this leaking everywhere. I wiped some of it off before I took the picture. Not sure how much product I lost. Otherwise, this product is great.

Giving 3 stars because idk why I thought it would be bigger, I bought the coffee scrub too and it’s in a way bigger packaging but any I’ve been a long time user of St.Ives but most times I get it at the super market so first time ordering and I wished it was the usual size, this is kind of a travel size-ish 🫤🫤

I'm sure this product is going to be great. I've been buying the St Ives apricot scrub for many, many years and I love it. Thought I'd try this new Pink Lemon and Mandarin. I feel like I've been ripped off. Like everything in stores today, they jacked up the price and decreased the quantity. "The customer won't even notice". Thanks St Ives.
